title: Immersion patch: G(B̆_σ(a)) is a finite-measure C¹ submanifold
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, G : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+ℓ} be of class C¹, and a ∈ ℝⁿ such that DG(a) = fderiv ℝ G a is injective. Then there is σ > 0 such that G(B̆_σ(a)) (B̆_σ(a) = ball a σ, the open ball) is an n-dimensional C¹ submanifold in the sense of IsC1Submanifold n and Hⁿ(G(B̆_σ(a))) < ∞ (Hⁿ = μHE[n]).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (G : Rn n → Amb n ℓ) (a : Rn n), ContDiff ℝ 1 G → Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ G a) → ∃ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ ∧ IsC1Submanifold n (G '' ball a σ) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (G '' ball a σ) < ∞
